name: Zu Peshawar (TransPeshawar BRT)
operator: TransPeshawar (Urban Mobility Company), under KP Urban Mobility Authority
payment: Zu card (stored value; card price Rs400 from Dec 2024; recharge at stations, Zu mobile app, JazzCash, Easypaisa); single-journey ticket Rs70

fare_rules.concessions: Single-journey ticket Rs70. Express buses running on feeder routes: flat Rs55. Senior citizens (60+) 50% with special card; children under 5 free with parents (2024 reports).

hours.notes: Official operation-hours page: ~16 h/day 06:00-22:00; ER-01 last departure 20:30 (from 13 Jul 2026). Corridor headway reported 3 min peak / 5 min off-peak (Wikipedia).
